name: Agent
description: Spawn a delegated resident subagent to work on a focused task. Returns immediately by default — the child's result arrives later as a child message that wakes you. Set wait=true only when you need the initial result before continuing.

subagent_type.description: Named agent profile from this runtime's configured agents. OMIT unless the runtime has agent profiles configured — most have none, and any value then fails the spawn.

wait.description: Block until the child's initial result (default false: return at spawn, result arrives as a child message).
